name: pilot-10k-8192
description: Exploratory ceiling probe: 10,240 requested input tokens with an 8192-token output ceiling. The 2048-token pilot censored 7 of 20 responses, all reasoning-only; this cell asks whether that subpopulation terminates by 8192. 8192 is a declared probe value, not a provider-verified output limit. A clean result does not certify the ceiling and does not authorize a multiwindow run.

qualification.note: Exploratory ceiling evidence only. It is excluded from future qualification evidence and cannot qualify an endpoint.
